notes:
## New features & enhancements

- Song titles: while a station plays, the line under its name shows the artist and title of the song that is on, for stations that publish it, and pulses briefly when the song changes. The mini radio shows it too. Stations that do not publish it keep their tagline.
- On Windows, an optional helper reads titles from the stream itself for many more stations. It is off until you turn it on in Settings, and connects for about a second once a minute while such a station plays.
- Settings has a new General tab, first in the row: song titles, Play on launch, Start when you sign in and the update check now live there.
- The station finder matches the words you type rather than the exact phrase, and lists stations the directory could not verify instead of hiding them, so stations that only stream to their own country turn up.
- The Add station key opens the Stations tab without starting a blank station, so you can search or add one yourself.
- Opening a station in Settings scrolls it into view when it would have unfolded below the bottom of the list.
- The mini radio shows whether it is live, connecting or stopped in its top-left corner, with the same coloured status light as the main radio.
- Enhancements to seasonal themes.

## Bug fixes

- The "updated to" announcement after an update now shrinks to fit on every theme instead of running off the right-hand edge.
- On Rogers stations, a new song title waits longer before it shows, so it no longer appears while the previous song is still playing.
- On some laptops the window no longer resizes back and forth, with a scrollbar flickering, while it fits itself to the radio on opening.
- Fixes in seasonal themes.
